messages.content: 請為我在奧斯汀找到一把Yamaha Acoustic Guitar的最低價格，並將其與紐約Yamaha Acoustic Guitar的平均價格進行比較。同時告訴我每個城市有多少家商店有販售Yamaha Acoustic Guitar。

function.name: lowest_price
function.description: Returns the lowest price for a particular product within a given city. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

city.description: The city where the product will be searched.

product.description: The product for which the lowest price will be searched.

function.name: average_price
function.description: Returns the average price for a particular product within a given city. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

city.description: The city where the product will be searched.

product.description: The product for which the average price will be searched.

function.name: store_count
function.description: Returns the number of stores that carry a particular product within a given city. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

city.description: The city where the product will be searched.

product.description: The product for which the number of stores will be searched.

function.name: product_search
function.description: Searches a particular product within a given city. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

city.description: The city where the product will be searched.

product.description: The product that will be searched.

message.reasoning:
The user wants:

1) Lowest price for Yamaha Acoustic Guitar in Austin.

2) Average price for Yamaha Acoustic Guitar in New York.

Also want count of stores selling it in each city (Austin and NYC).

We need to call relevant functions: lowest_price(city="Austin", product="Yamaha Acoustic Guitar") ; average_price(city="New York", product="Yamaha Acoustic Guitar"); store_count(city=..., product=...). We also might need store counts for both cities.

Thus we should make calls accordingly.

We'll use the tool "lowest_price" with arguments {city:"Austin", product:"Yamaha Acoustic Guitar"}; then "average_price" with args {city:"New York", product:"Yamaha Acoustic Guitar"}; Then "store_count" twice: one for Austin, one for New York.

Return results nicely formatted.

Let's do first call.
